items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: The change is in the measure of the screen and coarseness that Aba ve Ima arouse in themselves, at the time they couple upon the Mayin Nukvin of ZA. For example, at the time of the first gestation, Aba ve Ima arouse the phase of the screen of the externality of themselves, where there is only the level of Nefesh. And in the phase of nursing they arouse the phase of the screen of phase Aleph within themselves, in which there is a level of the light of Ruach, this screen coming from their middle vessels. And in the phase of Gadlut they arouse in themselves the phase of the screen of phase Bet, in which there is a level of Neshama, which they arouse from their inner vessels. Therefore, the phase of the Tzelem of gestation is the phase of Nefesh in an outer vessel. And the phase of the Tzelem of nursing is the phase of Ruach in a middle vessel. And the phase of the Tzelem of Gadlut is the phase of Neshama in an inner vessel. (Item 144 and 145)
